run_server: run the sglang inference server with prepared server arguments for HTTP, gRPC, or Ray mode
prepare_server_args: prepare server arguments from command-line sys.argv for sglang inference server configuration
launch_server_http: launch the sglang HTTP inference server from sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server
launch_server_grpc: launch the sglang gRPC inference server from sglang.srt.entrypoints.grpc_server
kill_process_tree: kill the sglang inference server process tree when the server shuts down
